# TPC-Havoc Q16_v3

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  p.p_brand,
  p.p_type,
  p.p_size,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_cnt
FROM part AS p
INNER JOIN partsupp AS ps
  ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    s_suppkey
  FROM supplier
  WHERE
    s_comment LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%'
) AS excluded_suppliers
  ON ps.ps_suppkey = excluded_suppliers.s_suppkey
WHERE
  p.p_brand <> 'Brand#45'
  AND NOT p.p_type LIKE 'MEDIUM POLISHED%'
  AND p.p_size IN (49, 14, 23, 45, 19, 3, 36, 9)
  AND excluded_suppliers.s_suppkey IS NULL
GROUP BY
  p.p_brand,
  p.p_type,
  p.p_size
ORDER BY
  supplier_cnt DESC,
  p.p_brand,
  p.p_type,
  p.p_size
```
